about_the_game:
You ever wanted a hyper simulation game about cars, where every switch works and every warning light on the instrument cluster matters?

Welcome to the Car World

A passion project built by one developer - a true car enthusiast creating the ultimate experience for fellow car lovers. Discover what makes Car World the most detailed car simulation ever made:

Every System Fully Simulated

  • Unique instrument cluster for every vehicle (both gasoline and diesel)

  • Lighting system with all car lights including interior and exterior (position lights, low/high beam, fog lights (front and rear), turn signal lights, brake lights, reverse lights, even a license plate lights)

  • Air condition system with both automatic dual zone and manual ac. This is very important in the game because temperature is a great factor in this game. Also, windshield can get foggy

  • Radio system with 10 radio stations and MP3 support so you can play your own music from your PC. Volume control, seek and fine tune FM radio frequency, FM RDS, settings including bass, treble, balance and fade, mute option, MP3 fast forward and rewind... Radio screen is consisting of 14-segment characters that gives it realistic look

  • All four windows simulated (power windows and manual cranking windows)

  • Fully simulated cruise control with functions (set, cancel, increase and decrease speed)

  • Manual gearbox and automatic gearbox with manual shifting possibility

  • Handbrake electronic and mechanic

  • Ignition system keyless and with key

  • Windshield wipers with 3 speed and windshield washing function

  • Glovebox and trunk storage for various items

  • Car lock and unlock

Car Fixing and Maintenance

Car can break down due to wear and tear, bad maintenance (ignoring oil changes, changing filters etc.) or improper usage (high revving when engine is cold, shifting in very low gear or reverse while rpms are high...). Some of the problems will turn on warning lamp, some you can tell by looking at the exhaust smoke color.

  • Change all your fluids regularly (engine oil, coolant, transmission oil, power steering fluid, brake fluid, differential oil). And don't forget to refill your windshield washer fluid. There are three variations of engine oil, three types of coolant, and two types of transmission oil. Also winter and summer version of windshield washer fluid. You can mix fluids and achieve perfect coolant : water ratio for the outside temperature. But your car can mix fluids too if not maintained properly (coolant in oil, etc.)

  • Ensure that your tires always have adequate pressure in them

  • Check your brake discs and brake pads regularly and replace them if needed

  • Check if your car battery will be able to survive the cold winter

  • Check spark plugs and coils so your gasoline engine can run smooth. Also don't forget glow plugs and fuel injectors on your diesel

  • Pour only high quality fuel in your high performance engine (3 types of gasoline and diesel available)

  • Or do an engine swap (various engines available including V8 and V12)

Car Customization

  • Exterior and Interior color

  • Interior lighting color

  • Different light bulbs (halogen, xenon, led) that you can use to replace your factory light bulbs

  • Rims with different sizes that you can buy in color you want or paint them yourself

  • Different tires including summer, winter, all season and off road

  • Windows tinting

  • Adaptive suspension adjust if your car have one

  • You can swap manual AC for automatic AC in older car

Open World Experience

  • Fully simulated open world with day and night cycle (including calendar, sunrise and sunset times are adjusted according to the current day and month)

  • Realistic seasons and weather (hail can damage your windshield)

  • Realistic traffic lights (on weekends they flash yellow light only)

  • NPC pedestrians and cars

  • Trash bins where you can throw your items or maybe find something interesting

  • Various stores including supermarket for everyday life items and car parts store

  • Traffic signs that you need to obey, or you are lucky and maybe you go unpunished

  • There can be sudden power outages in the city and in your home. Also water outages, so be prepared

Survival Segment

  • Manage your character and story however you want but don't go bankrupt

  • Take care of yourself like in real life, drink water regularly, eat, use toilet, shower, sleep and look for speeding cars when you cross a street on a red light

  • Earn money by doing some jobs with or without your car and, for example, finance your dream car project (buy used supercar, fix it and restore its like-new condition) or just earn enough money to buy a new supercar by flipping other cars and selling them for profit. Choice is yours

  • Take care of your home and garage by paying monthly bills for water used and electricity (house heating or cooling is using electricity)

Your Character and House

  • Fully customizable character

  • Two-story house with garage (with many tools required to work on a car) and rooms with interactable elements (light switches, window blinds, fridge, sink, tv, bed, toilet, bath, basin, washing machine and various storages)

  • Personal accessories including (wristwatches, interactable car keys, flashlights...)

  • Backpack as a main storage that player always carry, with option to expand it with bags that you can carry. Also, large items you can't fit in the backpack and you need to carry them in hands and put them in a larger storage

  • Mobile phone with various apps (weather forecast, GPS maps, online banking app, your MP3 songs library...). Battery of the phone is draining so don't forget to put it to charge overnight

  • Take care of your clothes, they can get dirty working on a car, so you need to wash them in a washing machine

  • Realistic wallet simulated with banknotes and coins of different values you can use to purchase items. Or you can pay for items simply by using a bank card

Every feature in Car World is built with care - from the cold start engine sound to the car interior lighting in the dark. It's more than just about cars. It's about living with them, maintaining them, and understanding their systems while managing your life.

Car World isn't just a game - it's a tribute to every car lover who believes that machines have a soul.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 2D game with advanced lighting and weather simulation effects. A dedicated GPU is recommended for smoother experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Car World is a realistic 2D driving and life simulator focused on true car ownership and maintenance. Drive, repair, and tune your vehicles, take jobs or trade them for profit. Every car system is simulated down to the smallest detail. Can you prove yourself as a true car enthusiast?
